cases.title: Enforce multi-tenant data isolation: School User cannot view or create classes for another school
cases.environment: Admin Portal localhost:5173; School User of School A ('SCH-RI-01')
cases.preconditions: School A has classes ['P1-A', 'P1-B']. School B ('SCH-ACS-02') has classes ['P1-ALPHA', 'P1-BETA'].
cases.test_steps:
1. Log in as School A user and view classes list.
2. Verify no classes from School B appear in table.
3. Intercept POST /school/v1/schools/classes and inject foreign schoolId 'SCH-ACS-02'.
cases.expected_result: Only School A classes are visible; forged API request is rejected with HTTP 403 Forbidden / school context mismatch.
cases.assumption_ref: R3 FS v1.1 §5.2 Access Control; BR-R3-05

cases.title: Reject class creation if selected Level Offering belongs to another school
